# `toolu commands`

List every toolu command; --json exports the tree for tools and docs.

Owner: built into `crates/cli`.

## `toolu commands`

```text
List every toolu command; --json exports the tree for tools and docs

Usage: toolu commands [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --schema            Print the JSON Schema of every --json document instead
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, opencode, cursor, hermes]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```
